## Not simulated

- devices.accel.signals.int1: not wired in the twin (no model output); firmware paths using it are untested in simulation

## Twin compromises (SoC-level)

- I2C uses the legacy TWI peripheral (nordic,nrf-twi) instead of TWIM: Renode models TWI only. Functionally identical; TWIM would use EasyDMA and fewer interrupts. Switch by deleting dt_compatible once a TWIM model exists.
- The nRF52840 flash controller (NVMC) is a minimal Python model (renode/nrf52840_nvmc.py): page erase and READY only.
- SAADC (battery measurement) is not modelled.
